Problem Statement:
Kumar has been given the task of building a login system for his company.Since he was busy , Kumar’s assistant took up the job and made a very weak system which only considers the password and not the username of the user. The system works in such a way that after every time the user types a character the system checks if the password entered so far matches with a password in the system. This system has some obvious shortcomings due to the fact that when a user’s password is the prefix of another user’s password the second user gets logged into the first user’s account. This is a major security flaw.Kumar finds this out and decides to rectify this by deciding what password must be allowed to be created or not.You are given N strings : the password strings currently present in the system . It is guaranteed there is no problem in these passwords.You are also given Q queries , in each query you will be given a string and you will have to determine if the string will break the system or not.Note: All strings consist of lowercase alphabets
input_spec: The first line contains a single integer N denoting the number of passwords present in the system initiallyThe next N line contains a single string each of length at most 100 denoting the passwords in the system initiallyThe next line contains a single integer Q denoting the number of queries you will be askedThe next Q line contains a single integer each denoting that a user wants to create a certain password .
output_spec: Your output must consist of Q line : one line per queryEach line must consist either “Allowed” if the password won’t break the system Or “Invalid” If the password will break the system . (Don’t print quotes for output)
